open_points.subject: execute_function
open_points.text: The parent MUST enforce from outside a wall deadline, the monotonic_ns reading taken when the environment starts plus bounds.wall_time_ms in nanoseconds and held in a local variable of execute_function only, after which — once a later monotonic_ns reading reaches it — it kills every process of the environment by sending SIGKILL, through a pidfd, to the environment's PID-namespace init, the child-pid bubblewrap reports on --info-fd — not to bubblewrap itself or its process group — and then waits for bubblewrap to exit.
open_points.other_text: It opens the pidfd of that child-pid at once, and a wall deadline or channel bound passed before the report arrived is acted on when it arrives.
open_points.question: Must the environment be killed as soon as the deadline or channel bound is observed, or may killing be deferred until the --info-fd report arrives?
